title: Eliminar puntos de entrega antiguos: solo quedan las casas house
request: Eliminar los puntos de envio actuales; solo deben quedar los lugares llamados house para entregar pedidos. DestinationPurger quita el tag DeliveryDestination y destruye los pads que no cuelgan de un objeto house. HouseBuilder v4 soporta multiples parts house, cada uno con su casa y su puerta de entrega.

operations.source:
--============================================================
-- DESTINATION PURGER: elimina los puntos de entrega antiguos
-- Solo quedan como destino las puertas dentro de un 'house'
--============================================================
local Workspace = game:GetService('Workspace')
local CollectionService = game:GetService('CollectionService')

local function hasHouseAncestor(inst)
  local node = inst.Parent
  while node and node ~= game do
    if string.lower(node.Name) == 'house' then
      return true
    end
    node = node.Parent
  end
  return false
end

-- esperar a que la ciudad termine de construirse y etiquetar
local city = Workspace:WaitForChild('DeliveryCity', 30)
if not city then
  warn('[DestinationPurger] no aparecio DeliveryCity')
else
  task.wait(1)
end

local removed = 0
local kept = 0
for _, inst in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged('DeliveryDestination')) do
  if inst:IsA('BasePart') then
    if hasHouseAncestor(inst) then
      kept += 1
    else
      CollectionService:RemoveTag(inst, 'DeliveryDestination')
      inst:Destroy()
      removed += 1
    end
  end
end

-- alternativa soportada por DeliveryService: carpeta workspace.Destinations
local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild('Destinations')
if folder then
  folder:Destroy()
  warn('[DestinationPurger] carpeta workspace.Destinations eliminada')
end

print('[DestinationPurger] eliminados ' .. removed .. ' puntos antiguos')

task.delay(5, function()
  local n = 0
  for _, inst in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged('DeliveryDestination')) do
    if inst:IsA('BasePart') and hasHouseAncestor(inst) then
      n += 1
    end
  end
  print('[DestinationPurger] destinos activos ahora: ' .. n .. ' (solo casas house)')
end)

--============================================================
-- HOUSE BUILDER v4: una casa DENTRO de cada Part llamado house
-- y cada puerta se convierte en punto de entrega con animacion
--============================================================
local Workspace = game:GetService('Workspace')
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService('ServerScriptService')
local CollectionService = game:GetService('CollectionService')

-->>>> ANIMACION: pega tu ID aqui, ej. rbxassetid://123456789 <<<<
local ANIM_ID = 'rbxassetid://0'

local DOOR_NAME = '🏠 Casa Nueva'

local function findAllByName(root, target, timeout)
  local deadline = os.clock() + timeout
  target = string.lower(target)
  local found = {}
  repeat
    table.clear(found)
    local stack = { root }
    while #stack > 0 do
      local inst = table.remove(stack)
      for _, child in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
        if string.lower(child.Name) == target then
          table.insert(found, child)
        end
        table.insert(stack, child)
      end
    end
    if #found > 0 then
      return found
    end
    task.wait(0.5)
  until os.clock() >= deadline
  return found
end

local function findByName(root, target, timeout)
  local deadline = os.clock() + timeout
  target = string.lower(target)
  repeat
    local stack = { root }
    while #stack > 0 do
      local inst = table.remove(stack)
      for _, child in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
        if string.lower(child.Name) == target then
          return child
        end
        table.insert(stack, child)
      end
    end
    task.wait(0.5)
  until os.clock() >= deadline
  return nil
end

---------------- DELIVERY SERVICE (require perezoso, compartido) ----------------
local DeliveryService
do
  local ok, mod = pcall(function()
    local folder = ServerScriptService:WaitForChild('DeliveryServer', 10)
    local m = folder and folder:WaitForChild('DeliveryService', 10)
    if m then
      return require(m)
    end
    return nil
  end)
  if ok and type(mod) == 'table' then
    DeliveryService = mod
  end
end

local function playDoorAnimation(player, anim)
  if ANIM_ID == 'rbxassetid://0' then
    return
  end
  local char = player.Character
  local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
  if not hum then
    return
  end
  local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass('Animator')
  if not animator then
    animator = Instance.new('Animator')
    animator.Parent = hum
  end
  local ok, track = pcall(function()
    return animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
  end)
  if ok and track then
    track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
    track:Play()
  end
end

local lastUse = {}

local function setupDoor(door, doorName)
  CollectionService:AddTag(door, 'DeliveryDestination')
  door:SetAttribute('DestName', doorName)

  local prompt = Instance.new('ProximityPrompt')
  prompt.Name = 'DoorPrompt'
  prompt.ActionText = 'Tocar la puerta'
  prompt.ObjectText = doorName
  prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
  prompt.HoldDuration = 0.25
  prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
  prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
  prompt.Parent = door

  local anim = Instance.new('Animation')
  anim.Name = 'DoorAnimation'
  anim.AnimationId = ANIM_ID
  anim.Parent = door

  prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
    local now = os.clock()
    if lastUse[player] and now - lastUse[player] < 1.5 then
      return
    end
    lastUse[player] = now
    playDoorAnimation(player, anim)
    if DeliveryService then
      local s = DeliveryService.Sessions[player]
      if s then
        pcall(DeliveryService.TryDeliver, player, door)
      end
    end
  end)
end

local function buildHouse(plot, index)
  -- el solar NO debe caerse: si cae bajo el mapa, Roblox lo destruye con la casa dentro
  plot.Anchored = true
  if plot:FindFirstChild('CasaNueva') then
    return
  end

  local door = findByName(plot, 'puerta', 5)
  if not door or not door:IsA('BasePart') then
    door = Instance.new('Part')
    door.Name = 'puerta'
    door.Anchored = true
    door.Size = Vector3.new(4.6, 7, 1)
    door.CFrame = plot.CFrame
    door.Parent = plot
  end

  ---------------- MEDIDAS (nunca mas grande que el part) ----------------
  local size = plot.Size
  local W = math.max(size.X * 0.86, 6)
  local D = math.max(size.Z * 0.86, 6)
  local baseY, wallH
  if size.Y >= 8 then
    baseY = -size.Y / 2
    wallH = math.clamp(size.Y * 0.8, 6.5, 60)
    plot.Transparency = 1
    plot.CanCollide = false
  else
    baseY = size.Y / 2
    wallH = math.clamp(math.min(W, D) * 0.55, 8, 16)
    plot.Transparency = 0.55
  end

  ---------------- FRENTE HACIA LA PUERTA ----------------
  local rel = plot.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(door.Position)
  local theta = 0
  if math.abs(rel.X) > math.abs(rel.Z) then
    if rel.X >= 0 then theta = -math.pi / 2 else theta = math.pi / 2 end
    W = math.max(size.Z * 0.86, 6)
    D = math.max(size.X * 0.86, 6)
  else
    if rel.Z >= 0 then theta = math.pi else theta = 0 end
  end
  local buildCF = plot.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, theta, 0)

  local C_WALL = Color3.fromRGB(236, 232, 224)
  local C_SIDE = Color3.fromRGB(214, 208, 198)
  local C_TRIM = Color3.fromRGB(70, 55, 45)
  local C_ROOF = Color3.fromRGB(68, 70, 76)
  local C_ACCENT = Color3.fromRGB(235, 170, 60)

  local model = Instance.new('Model')
  model.Name = 'CasaNueva'

  local function P(name, sx, sy, sz, x, y, z, color, mat, rotX)
    local p = Instance.new('Part')
    p.Name = name
    p.Size = Vector3.new(sx, sy, sz)
    p.CFrame = buildCF * CFrame.new(x, y, z)
    if rotX then
      p.CFrame = p.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(rotX, 0, 0)
    end
    p.Color = color
    p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    p.Anchored = true
    p.Parent = model
    return p
  end

  ---------------- PUERTA ----------------
  local wallT = 0.8
  local dw0 = math.max(door.Size.X, door.Size.Z)
  local doorW = math.clamp(math.max(dw0, 4.6), 3, math.max(3.2, W * 0.32))
  local doorH = math.clamp(math.max(door.Size.Y, 6.8), 5, wallH - 1.2)
  local ow = doorW + 0.6
  local oh = doorH + 0.35

  local doorName = DOOR_NAME
  if index > 1 then
    doorName = DOOR_NAME .. ' ' .. index
  end

  door.Name = doorName
  door.Size = Vector3.new(doorW, doorH, 1)
  door.CFrame = buildCF * CFrame.new(0, baseY + doorH / 2 + 0.05, -D / 2 + 0.5)
  door.Color = Color3.fromRGB(122, 74, 40)
  door.Material = Enum.Material.Wood
  door.Anchored = true
  door.CanCollide = true

  local knob = Instance.new('Part')
  knob.Name = 'Knob'
  knob.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
  knob.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
  knob.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 185, 90)
  knob.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
  knob.CanCollide = false
  knob.Anchored = true
  knob.CFrame = buildCF * CFrame.new(doorW / 2 - 0.7, baseY + doorH * 0.45, -D / 2 - 0.3)
  knob.Parent = model

  ---------------- PISO Y MUROS ----------------
  P('Floor', W, 0.5, D, 0, baseY + 0.25, 0, Color3.fromRGB(120, 95, 70), Enum.Material.Wood)

  local wL = (W - ow) / 2
  P('WallFrontL', wL, wallH, wallT, -(ow + W) / 4, baseY + wallH / 2, -D / 2 + wallT / 2, C_WALL)
  P('WallFrontR', wL, wallH, wallT, (ow + W) / 4, baseY + wallH / 2, -D / 2 + wallT / 2, C_WALL)
  P('WallFrontTop', ow, wallH - oh, wallT, 0, baseY + (oh + wallH) / 2, -D / 2 + wallT / 2, C_WALL)
  P('WallBack', W, wallH, wallT, 0, baseY + wallH / 2, D / 2 - wallT / 2, C_SIDE)
  P('WallLeft', wallT, wallH, D - 2 * wallT, -W / 2 + wallT / 2, baseY + wallH / 2, 0, C_SIDE)
  P('WallRight', wallT, wallH, D - 2 * wallT, W / 2 - wallT / 2, baseY + wallH / 2, 0, C_SIDE)

  ---------------- MARCO Y BANDA ----------------
  P('TrimL', 0.5, oh + 0.3, wallT + 0.2, -(ow / 2 + 0.25), baseY + (oh + 0.3) / 2, -D / 2 + wallT / 2, C_TRIM)
  P('TrimR', 0.5, oh + 0.3, wallT + 0.2, ow / 2 + 0.25, baseY + (oh + 0.3) / 2, -D / 2 + wallT / 2, C_TRIM)
  P('TrimTop', ow + 1, 0.5, wallT + 0.2, 0, baseY + oh + 0.25, -D / 2 + wallT / 2, C_TRIM)
  local band = P('AccentBand', W, 0.6, 0.15, 0, baseY + wallH - 0.7, -D / 2 - 0.08, C_ACCENT)
  band.CanCollide = false

  ---------------- TECHO A UNA AGUA (cabe en el part) ----------------
  local ov = math.min(1.4, size.X * 0.06, size.Z * 0.06)
  local roofAng = math.rad(10)
  local Lz = D + 2 * ov
  if size.Y >= 8 then
    local maxRise = size.Y - wallH - 0.55
    if maxRise < 0.5 then maxRise = 0.5 end
    local r = Lz * math.tan(roofAng)
    if r > maxRise then
      roofAng = math.atan(maxRise / Lz)
    end
  end
  local rise = Lz * math.tan(roofAng)
  local roofLen = Lz / math.cos(roofAng)
  P('Roof', W + 2 * ov, 0.6, roofLen, 0, baseY + wallH + 0.25 + rise / 2, 0, C_ROOF, Enum.Material.Slate, -roofAng)

  ---------------- VENTANAS ----------------
  if W >= 16 then
    for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
      for _, wz in ipairs({ -D / 4, D / 4 }) do
        local frame = P('WindowFrame', 0.35, 3.6, 4.4, sx * (W / 2 + 0.09), baseY + wallH * 0.58, wz, Color3.fromRGB(248, 248, 248))
        frame.CanCollide = false
        local glass = P('WindowGlass', 0.2, 3, 3.8, sx * (W / 2 + 0.2), baseY + wallH * 0.58, wz, Color3.fromRGB(165, 215, 240), Enum.Material.Glass)
        glass.CanCollide = false
        glass.Transparency = 0.25
      end
    end
  end

  ---------------- PORCHE ----------------
  local cd = math.clamp(size.Z * 0.06, 1.2, 3)
  P('Canopy', doorW + 3.4, 0.35, cd, 0, baseY + doorH + 1.1, -D / 2 - cd / 2 + 0.1, C_TRIM, Enum.Material.Wood)

  local mat1 = P('Doormat', doorW * 0.85, 0.1, 1.2, 0, baseY + 0.56, -D / 2 - 0.65, Color3.fromRGB(120, 35, 35))
  mat1.CanCollide = false

  local plen = math.max(1.2, size.Z * 0.07 - 0.4)
  local path = P('Path', doorW * 0.9, 0.14, plen, 0, baseY + 0.07, -D / 2 - plen / 2 + 0.2, Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 165), Enum.Material.Concrete)
  path.CanCollide = false

  local signY = math.min(baseY + doorH + 1.6, baseY + wallH - 0.9)
  local sign = P('Sign', math.min(doorW + 1.5, 8), 1.3, 0.3, 0, signY, -D / 2 - 0.24, Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 48))
  sign.CanCollide = false
  local gui = Instance.new('SurfaceGui')
  gui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
  local lbl = Instance.new('TextLabel')
  lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  lbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
  lbl.Text = string.upper(doorName)
  lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
  lbl.TextScaled = true
  lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 140)
  lbl.Parent = gui
  gui.Parent = sign

  local bulb = P('PorchBulb', 0.9, 0.9, 0.9, doorW / 2 + 1.3, baseY + doorH + 0.5, -D / 2 - 0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 242, 195), Enum.Material.Neon)
  bulb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
  bulb.CanCollide = false
  local bl = Instance.new('PointLight')
  bl.Range = 16
  bl.Brightness = 1.3
  bl.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 190)
  bl.Parent = bulb
  CollectionService:AddTag(bulb, 'StreetLight')

  ---------------- INTERIOR ----------------
  local rug = P('Rug', math.min(6, W * 0.4), 0.08, math.min(7, D * 0.4), 0, baseY + 0.55, 1.5, Color3.fromRGB(140, 45, 45))
  rug.CanCollide = false
  P('Crate1', 2.4, 2.4, 2.4, W / 2 - 2.6, baseY + 1.7, D / 2 - 2.6, Color3.fromRGB(160, 120, 70), Enum.Material.Wood)
  P('Crate2', 1.8, 1.8, 1.8, W / 2 - 2.7, baseY + 3.8, D / 2 - 2.7, Color3.fromRGB(178, 138, 88), Enum.Material.Wood)

  local lamp = P('CeilLamp', 1.3, 0.4, 1.3, 0, baseY + wallH - 0.6, 0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 246, 214), Enum.Material.Neon)
  lamp.CanCollide = false
  local il = Instance.new('PointLight')
  il.Range = math.max(W, D)
  il.Brightness = 1.1
  il.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 210)
  il.Parent = lamp
  CollectionService:AddTag(lamp, 'StreetLight')

  ---------------- ENTREGA + ANIMACION ----------------
  setupDoor(door, doorName)

  model.Parent = plot
  print('[HouseBuilder] casa lista en ' .. plot:GetFullName() .. ' · destino: ' .. doorName)
end

---------------- BUSCAR TODOS LOS 'house' Y CONSTRUIR ----------------
local plots = findAllByName(Workspace, 'house', 30)
if #plots == 0 then
  warn('[HouseBuilder] no existe ningun objeto llamado house en Workspace')
  return
end

local count = 0
for _, plot in ipairs(plots) do
  if plot:IsA('BasePart') then
    if not plot:FindFirstChild('CasaNueva') then
      count += 1
      local ok, err = pcall(buildHouse, plot, count)
      if not ok then
        warn('[HouseBuilder] error en ' .. plot:GetFullName() .. ': ' .. tostring(err))
        count -= 1
      end
    end
  else
    warn('[HouseBuilder] ' .. plot:GetFullName() .. ' no es un Part, se omite')
  end
end
print('[HouseBuilder] total de casas house activas: ' .. count)
